summary: Frontend-only validation of the WebsiteEditor (/pagina-web) reorganization from 11 tabs to 5 task-based tabs plus the new 'Secciones del sitio' accordion. All 12 requested checks PASS. Logged in as demo-template@ezunitech.com. Editor renders with exactly 5 top tabs (website-tab-crear/secciones/diseno/funciones/publicar) and defaults to 'secciones'. The sections-accordion renders. Hero is expanded by default and exposes website-headline, website-hero-tagline, website-subheadline, hero photo picker and secbg-hero. Clicking a section-head-<key> expands that section and clicking again collapses it (verified for hero, services, about, gallery, beforeafter, how, why, faq, areas, contact). Expanded Services section shows the full services editor (website-suggest-services, recover-service-images-btn, website-service-0, website-service-add). Reorderable rows all have section-up-<k>/section-down-<k>/section-toggle-<k> for services/about/gallery/how/why/faq/areas (and solutions/samples/products/feature/logos/stats/reviews/map/band also render). Persistence verified via save+reload: (1) edited website-headline to 'TEST_HL_<ts>' persisted; (2) toggling section-toggle-about to off persisted (data-state=unchecked after reload); (3) moving 'how' down via section-down-how swapped order with 'why' and the new order survived reload (writes to w.sections / w.section_order confirmed by DOM order of section-head testids). Diseno tab shows 11 templates (website-tpl-*) + 9 brand colors (website-color-*). Funciones tab shows website-form-contact, website-form-booking, website-chat-toggle. Publicar tab shows website-publish, website-copy, website-slug, website-seo-title, website-seo-desc, website-domains plus Version History and Sitemap panels. Crear con IA tab shows website-ai-brief, website-ai-generate, website-stock-photos, website-translate-es, website-translate-en (not clicked per instruction). Verified in source that the old gated blocks (tab==='media'|'problem'|'agency'|'content'|'sections') remain in /app/frontend/src/pages/WebsiteEditor.js but are gated to tab names no longer in the TABS array, so they do NOT render — no ghost/duplicate rendering observed. Zero console errors throughout the flow. Edits made during testing were restored at the end (headline back to 'Powering Latino Businesses', about toggle re-enabled, 'how' moved back up, saved).
critical_code_review_comments: WebsiteEditor.js is now 2708 lines — well over the 700-line guideline. The reorganization added the accordion but did NOT delete the old per-type tab render blocks (tab==='media'/'problem'/'agency'/'content'/'sections' at lines 753/836/838/959/1443/1533). They are harmless (gated to tab names not in TABS) but add ~800 lines of dead code and increase maintenance risk. Recommend splitting Sections / Services / AI / Publish / Design into separate components and deleting the dead gated blocks.

Default landing tab is 'secciones' (line 61) and default expanded section is 'hero' (line 64) — good UX. However, the openSec state resets to 'hero' on every mount, so toggling a reorderable section off then navigating away and back will re-collapse the user's working section. Minor UX nit, not a bug.

Section Row header uses onClick on the entire header plus stopPropagation on reorder arrows and toggle switch — works correctly, but relying on stopPropagation is fragile. Prefer separate clickable chevron region.
seed_data_creation: All testing edits were restored at end of run (headline, about toggle, how/why order). No residual test data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Editor route is /pagina-web. Default tab = secciones, default expanded accordion = hero. Reorderable section_order is w.section_order filtered to SECTION_KEYS; fixed rows (not reorderable, no toggle) are hero + beforeafter + contact. For reorder tests, read DOM order of [data-testid^=section-head-] elements before/after clicking section-down-<k>. Toggle state can be read via data-state attribute on the Switch (checked/unchecked). Save button is data-testid=website-save-top. Backend persists via PUT /api/website with keys headline, sections, section_order, section_colors.
rca of the issue: No bugs found. Reorganization is working end-to-end: all 5 tabs render, all section testids are present, accordion expand/collapse works, and edits to headline + section toggle + section reorder all persist across reload.
